articles.title: 1 Industrials Stock on Our Buy List and 2 Facing Challenges
articles.mainIdea: 1 Industrials Stock on Our Buy List and 2 Facing Challenges
articles.summary: StockStory: 1 Industrials Stock on Our Buy List and 2 Facing Challenges. Even if they go mostly unnoticed, industrial businesses are the backbone of our country. They are also bound to benefit from a friendlier regulatory environment with the Trump administration, and this excitement has led to a six-month gain of 3.7% for the sector. Investing here would have been wise - at the same time, the S&P 500 fell by 5.5%. Related tickers mentioned: FLNC, XPO, ^GSPC.
